title: Research: the P104 no-relay access-cover minimum is 4,580
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The frozen P104 correction screen previously supplied a 4,480 no-relay carrier lower bound. This package independently reconstructs its exact weighted bound and strengthens it to **4,580 carrier lifetimes**. A 0/1 dual marks 4,580 required entries with at most one per admissible carrier; a matching cover of all 4,992 correction entries proves the access-cover relaxation has minimum exactly 4,580, integrally and fractionally.

The new result is a finite certificate plus a written program-to-cover proof. The proof makes the fixed source/target chronology explicit: useful reads precede useful writes because X finishes at cut 1533 and Y starts moving at cut 2526. A two-dimensional interleaving example shows why retiming cannot silently be allowed. **The primal is a support cover, not an attaining physical correction circuit.** No paid recursive profile, stock bound, supplier or new kappa is claimed. Native phases, scalar coefficients, actual contact timing, restoration, hosting, precision and all-size admission remain separate obligations.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12.3, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-no-relay-cover-audit --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-no-relay-cover-audit
```

The source-binding baseline, metadata/pins and registered replay pass. The final registered replay took 9.963 seconds and includes both checkers and all five public-CLI tests. All package bytes remain unchanged by verification.

- Primary antichain DP: 221 source frames, 220 target frames, 5724 nested frame pairs, 5804 candidate rectangles and 4638 maximal rectangles. The old fraction `24831791/5544` is exactly reproduced.
- Separate set/recursive-chain replay, importing neither the primary checker nor predecessor code: 6942 unpruned rectangles; primal and dual both 4580.
- Certificate: 4368 forced singleton entries plus 212 additional marked entries and 212 additional rectangles. Deterministic regeneration is byte-identical; SHA256 `311a169a98386a011639c360f0f3296e3b32bb06eee165e7c47698c6173e7633`.
- Twelve primary control groups and two separate certificate controls pass. Five CLI tests pass for optimized read-only Git-free export, source/certificate/receipt corruption, deterministic regeneration and occupied-output protection. The focused readonly test passed during iteration; the complete focused test file passed in the final registered run.

Not run: native Gaussian recipes, all 280 scalar endpoint columns, a chronological coefficient/restoration construction, relay-enabled networks, global owners/hosting, productive coverage pricing, precision/all-size/compiler admission or the selected cold replay. Frozen sources and the selected frontier are unchanged. No hosted CI or independent human review is claimed.

The registered replay (both checkers) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about ten seconds and left the worktree unchanged. The certificate arithmetic checks by hand: 4,368 forced singletons plus 212 further dual witnesses give 4,580, equal to the primal cover; the previous fraction 24831791/5544 is about 4,479.04 and rounds up to 4,480.

## Open next questions

The access-cover relaxation is solved: stronger weights within it cannot beat 4,580. A further no-relay refinement would need actual contact-time or coefficient constraints; start with one 23-entry component only if that sharper obstruction would affect a decision. The route was already unfavorable under the prior screen.

A constructive direction must change the no-relay premise, for example through priced helper-to-helper relays or retained descending values. Check current Discussion #2245 claims first, then establish one target's source acquisition, dirty restoration and complete local bill. The 4,580 floor is not asserted for such networks. Structured questions and blockers are in TASK.json.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The explicit excluded-coverage paragraph in PR2353 made a useful independent audit easy to identify. The shorter board statement “at most 12 pairs, so 4480 carriers” hides the weighted argument; attaching the exact fractional objective and a one-line model boundary to future summaries would reduce repeated orientation and hypothesis drift.
